parsed.rationale: The two `body` computed properties in `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView` and `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView` share a Jaccard similarity of 0.714, indicating substantial structural overlap in their SwiftUI view bodies. Both live in the same package (`app:iOS`) and the same directory (`WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Views/`), and neither carries any restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false). The divergence between small and medium widget layouts is typically parameterisable (e.g., via a `WidgetFamily` or size enum), so a single shared `NowPlayingWidgetEntryView` that accepts a size parameter can replace both, eliminating the near-duplicate `body` implementations.
